title: Research data management training at the National University of Kyiv-Mohyla Academy in Ukraine
what_changed: EIFL's Open Access Programme Manager, Iryna Kuchma, will facilitate a research data management training for researchers at the National University of Kyiv-Mohyla Academy in Ukraine (9 December 2026, online), building research data management capacity at a Ukrainian university.
why_it_matters: Research data management skills are a prerequisite for open data sharing and reuse; the training is part of EIFL's ongoing Open Access Programme work in Ukraine, turning national open-data ambitions into practical skills.
